text.div:
• Penicillin (criticality high): Anaphylaxis
  • Birch pollen (criticality low): Allergic rhinitis (hay fever) in spring

• Heart failure (NYHA II, reduced ejection fraction)
  • Atrial fibrillation, permanent
  • Type 2 diabetes mellitus, insulin treated
  • Angina pectoris, stable
  • Emphysema
  • Hypertension
  • Venous leg ulcer, left lower leg
  • Locally advanced prostate cancer (cT3a N0 M0), on androgen deprivation therapy
  • Femoral neck fracture, right (Garden IV), fall in Reykjavík

• Insulin glargine 100 units/ml (Lantus): 20 units subcutaneously in the evening
  • Metformin 500 mg tablet: 500 mg twice daily with meals
  • Apixaban 2.5 mg tablet (Eliquis): 2.5 mg twice daily
  • Ramipril 5 mg tablet: 5 mg once daily in the morning
  • Furosemide 40 mg tablet: 40 mg once daily in the morning
  • Bisoprolol 5 mg tablet: 5 mg once daily in the morning
  • Glyceryl trinitrate 0.4 mg/dose sublingual spray: 1 to 2 doses under the tongue as needed for chest pain
  • Tiotropium 2.5 microgram/dose inhalation solution (Spiriva Respimat): 2 inhalations once daily
  • Leuprorelin 22.5 mg depot injection (Eligard): 22.5 mg subcutaneously every 3 months, next dose 15 January 2027
  • Paracetamol 1 g tablet: 1 g three times daily for 14 days after surgery
• Cemented bipolar hemiarthroplasty of the right hip, 2026-11-10

• Haemoglobin: 102 g/L
  • Creatinine: 136 umol/L
  • eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021): 42 mL/min/1.73m2
  • HbA1c (IFCC): 62 mmol/mol
  • Potassium: 4.1 mmol/L
  • CRP: 38 mg/L
  • PSA: 1.8 ug/L

• Blood pressure: 132/74 mmHg
  • Heart rate: 78 beats/minute
  • Body weight: 74 kg

• Reduced mobility: walks with a rollator
  • Needs home care twice a day

• Tobacco smoking status: Former smoker, stopped 1995 (about 30 pack-years)
  • Living situation: Lives alone in a flat in Sjöbacka (widower)
• Wishes to be cared for at home in Sjöbacka, with his son involved, and consents to sharing his health data with his Swedish care providers

• Home care and support plan, Sjöbacka kommun
  • Follow-up at Vårdcentralen Kvarnängen

• Swedish regional public healthcare: Region Skåne
  • European Health Insurance Card (EHIC): Försäkringskassan (Swedish Social Insurance Agency)
